description: Compare two text files and return a unified diff from a to b. Use when you need line differences between two files on disk. Do not use it to find text across files; use `search_text` instead. To preview your own pending change, use the dryRun option of the write tools. Neither file is changed. Binary and non-UTF-8 files fail. A file over the size limit fails with TOO_LARGE. So does a diff not done within 1 s, or a full diff queue; retry once, then `read` matching line ranges. a is the - side and b the + side; swap them to reverse the diff. context only sets how many unchanged lines surround each hunk, not what counts as a change. Returns ---/+++ headers (basenames) and @@ hunks; identical files give headers only.

a.description: Original file; its lines are the - side

b.description: Changed file; its lines are the + side

context.description: Unchanged lines shown around each hunk; output size only

name: diff
title: Diff
